导入教程：各工具的令牌与导出: Import guide: each tool's token and export
只读取，不改原工具里的任何东西（Todoist 可选择在 Crossline 完: Read-only: nothing in the original tool changes (Todoist can optionally close a task once it is done in Crossline; off by default). Items read come with suggestions and are added only after one review screen.
在电脑浏览器登录 Todoist 网页版。: Sign in to Todoist on the web in a computer browser.
点左上角头像 →「设置」→「集成」→「开发者」。: Click the avatar at the top left → Settings → Integrations → Developer.
复制「API 令牌」（40 位字母数字），粘贴到下方「令牌」一栏，点「接入」。: Copy the API token (40 letters and digits), paste it into the token field below and click Connect.
接入后先读一遍全部未完成任务，给出核对清单；以后每天读一次新增的任务，可以关闭。: Once connected, all open tasks are read and listed for review; after that new tasks are read once a day, which can be switched off.
令牌能读写整个 Todoist 账号，只保存在服务器的加密存储里，不进账本和备份: The token can read and write the whole Todoist account. It is kept only in the server's encrypted storage, never in the ledger or backups, and deleted on disconnect; regenerating it in Todoist also voids the old one at once.
TickTick：在电脑浏览器登录 TickTick 网页版，点头像 →「Set: TickTick: sign in to TickTick on the web in a computer browser, click the avatar → Settings → Account → API Token, create and copy the token, paste it below and click Connect.
滴答清单（国内版）没有这个令牌：在网页版「设置」→「账户与安全」→「生成备份」，: Dida365 (the China edition) has no such token: on the web app go to Settings → Account & Security → Generate Backup, download the CSV and upload it below under Upload a CSV or screenshot.
TickTick 也可以用同样的备份 CSV 导入：「Settings」→「Ac: TickTick can be imported from the same backup CSV too: Settings → Account → Generate Backup.
TickTick 不回写：在 Crossline 完成的任务不会改动 TickT: Nothing is written back to TickTick: tasks finished in Crossline do not change TickTick.
打开 Notion 的集成页面，点「New integration」，类型选「I: Open Notion's integrations page, click New integration, choose Internal, name it Crossline, pick the workspace that holds the to-dos and save.
在集成的「Capabilities」里只勾选「Read content」，复制「: Under the integration's Capabilities tick only Read content, then copy the Internal Integration Secret (it starts with ntn_).
在 Notion 里打开要导入的数据库，点右上角「…」→「Connections: In Notion open the database to import and click … at the top right → Connections → Crossline. Without this step the integration cannot see the database.
回到这里粘贴令牌，点「接入」，在出现的列表里选这个数据库。: Come back here, paste the token, click Connect and pick the database from the list that appears.
标题、状态（Status / Select / 勾选框）、第一个日期属性、多选标: Title, state (Status / Select / checkbox), the first date property, multi-select tags
Notion 不回写。状态是 Done、Complete 或「已完成」的条目会建: Nothing is written back to Notion. Items whose state is Done, Complete or its Chinese equivalent are suggested as done.
能导出 CSV 的工具（Microsoft To Do 通过第三方导出、Thin: Tools that export CSV (Microsoft To Do through a third-party export, Things, Any.do, OmniFocus, an Excel sheet): export and upload the CSV below. The first row needs a title column (Title, Content, Task or the Chinese equivalent); date and status columns are read too.
只有文字的清单（备忘录、微信收藏、Markdown）：全选复制，粘贴到下方文本框: Lists that are only text (Notes, WeChat favourites, Markdown): select all, copy and paste into the box below, one item per line; lines with [x] count as done.
只能截图的（手机 App 的清单页）：截图后上传，系统逐行读出文字；读截图要用: Lists you can only screenshot (a phone app's list page): upload the screenshot and its text is read line by line; reading screenshots needs a ChatGPT sign-in.
提示令牌无效或已被撤销: It says the token is invalid or revoked
令牌复制不全，或已在原工具里重新生成过。重新复制完整令牌后再接入。: The token was copied incompletely or regenerated in the original tool. Copy the whole token again and reconnect.

这个服务没有正常回应，稍后再试。: The service did not answer properly. Try again later.
